manufacturers.bioShort: UK luminaire manufacturer, founded 1896. Part of Acuity Brands. 125+ years designing exterior and architectural lighting.
manufacturers.bio: Founded in London in 1896 by Pelham Trotter, Holophane's first product was a patented glass refractor that gave the company its name and set the direction for everything that followed: lighting engineered around optical performance, not just styling. Now part of Acuity Brands and manufacturing from its Milton Keynes facility, Holophane designs exterior, industrial and architectural luminaires with a focus on thermal management, serviceability and long system life — built to be repaired and upgraded in the field rather than replaced. Lumen Method is Holophane's exclusive specification agent for Australia.
